Un thème bleu et noir en hommage à Ado :: A blue and black theme in tribute to Ado: her artwork in the background, blue roses in the corners with sparkling gyaru stickers, Abo (the plush from the "I am Ado" meme) sitting on the edge of each panel and strolling along the taskbar, a scrolling list of her songs at the bottom and a bold, readable NeoDex title, also on the taskbar. A fan theme, not officially linked to the artist.
